'''Erich Weiss''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[The Witch House]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Evade]]
*+2 [[Spell]]

You cannot be [[delay|delayed]].

[[Category:Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]]

==Mythos Source==

Ehrich Weiss was the actual name of the escape artist and stage magician [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry_Houdini Harry Houdini].  He is arguably also a Mythos character as well, because Lovecraft ghost-wrote Houdini's "autobiographical" horror story ''Under the Pyramids'' (1924), as well as several of his anti-spiritualism tracts.
